description: This C# source file contains unit tests for broadcast channel functionality in an Orleans-based distributed system. It includes test classes, fixtures, and various test methods that validate publishing, subscribing, and message delivery features, as well as configurations for different delivery modes.

classes.name: BroadcastChannelTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying broadcast channel functionality including different delivery modes, multiple subscribers, and fault scenarios, using Orleans testing framework.

classes.name: BroadcastChannelTests.Fixture
classes.description: A fixture class that sets up the Orleans test cluster configuration, including broadcast channel providers.

classes.name: BroadcastChannelTests.Fixture.SiloConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo builder to add broadcast channel providers with specific options.

classes.name: BroadcastChannelTests.Fixture.ClientConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans client builder to add broadcast channel providers with options.

methods.name: ClientPublishSingleChannelTest
methods.description: Tests publishing messages to a single broadcast channel and verifies delivery to a subscriber grain.

methods.name: ClientPublishSingleChannelMultipleConsumersTest
methods.description: Tests publishing to a channel with multiple subscriber grains.

methods.name: ClientPublishMultipleChannelTest
methods.description: Tests publishing to multiple channels and verifies each message delivery.

methods.name: MultipleSubscribersOneBadActorChannelTest
methods.description: Tests behavior when multiple subscribers, including a bad actor, receive published messages.

methods.name: ClientPublishSingleChannelTestImpl
methods.description: Implementation of the single channel publish test, parameterized by provider and delivery mode.

methods.name: ClientPublishMultipleChannelTestImpl
methods.description: Implementation of multiple channel publish test.

methods.name: MultipleSubscribersChannelTestImpl
methods.description: Implementation testing multiple subscribers receiving messages.

methods.name: MultipleSubscribersOneBadActorChannelTestImpl
methods.description: Implements testing of a subscriber group with a malicious or faulty subscriber.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Helper method to poll until a certain number of values are received or timeout occurs.
